svg.title: How load times a task
svg.desc: The first edit opens a task. A background estimate gives p50 4m. The agent works 2 minutes, then waits 3 minutes on you: the clock pauses. It works 2 more minutes, the estimate runs out, and it re-estimates. git push closes the task after 1 more minute. A toast says Done in 5m (estimated 4m) · 3m waiting on you. The model explains why, and past tasks tune the next estimate.
